WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT
  oa.order_id,
  oa.average_quantity,
  oa.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
